title: 为网络硬件错误建立可执行告警证据包，要求区分链路物理错误、驱动丢弃与TCP重传。
answer: 交付每种错误计数的来源层次、单位、重置条件和排查入口。物理CRC、驱动队列drop和TCP重传分别解释，不用一个总error比率替代；关联接口身份、速度、双工与链路变化。验收物理测试或受控模拟证据、CPU高包率压力及应用重传，确认规则给出正确责任方向。硬件不支持某项时显示缺失而非零。若告警仅由设备名称复用造成跳变，先修正身份和窗口，不能立即安排换卡；修复后比较持续增量而非累计值清零。网卡重置后按计数器重置处理，不能产生负错误率或异常大增量。

rubric: 三类来源层次/单位/reset/资产身份/速度双工链路变化和责任入口完整分离
真实原生规则/API关联受控硬件统计与独立真实loopback证据，missing不当0，设备名复用不换卡
重置不负率或异常大增量，修复比较持续增量，完整包/清理/默认身份保持
body:
## 环境与材料
固定WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022、student UID1000，真实node_exporter1.9.1 textfile/netstat/netdev/cpu/stat，Prometheus3.5.0原生规则/API。CRC/driver/TCP重放明确为受控统计样本，不声称真实物理CRC/驱动drop。另有自有loopback socket真实包/CPU/TCP_INFO与SNMP重传证据。仅私有目录、高端口、PID；禁止改网卡、防火墙、sysctl、网络namespace、默认身份。

## 操作任务
完成rules.json三条每秒recording及四类alert（physical_crc/network_hardware、driver_drop/kernel_driver、transport/application_and_tcp_stack、hardware_unknown/asset_inventory）；保持native labels，关联当前asset/interface_id/boot_id及速度/双工/carrier/link_changes，设备名不能替代身份。rate窗口1s为本题有界教学重放窗口，生产窗口应按实际采样与业务另定。支持硬件字段真实0与不支持/缺失必须分开。重置处理不能出现负率或异常大增量。受控CRC/driver/TCP三类分别、混合、旧累计稳定、同设备名新身份、同身份计数reset及修复后持续增量都必须正确。保持policy.json的来源层次、单位、重置条件、责任入口与边界；不能仅凭名称复用、TCP重传或链路变化安排换卡。
完成report.py，读取实际生成的evidence-input.json和policy.json，生成evidence-package.json：schema/source_boundary/sources/asset_responsibility/phases/real_loopback/limitations。每个phase保留phase、完整identity、categories、owners、hardware_counter_state、replace_hardware=false、post_repair（repair_stable=no_increment、repair_regrowth=continuing_increment，其余not_applicable）、native_alerts、query_epoch及native_observations（完整phase原始查询/alert/textfile）；分类及责任来自实际native firing alerts，保留动态原始关联值，不能静态写固定答案。

## 产物
rules.json、policy.json、report.py；运行后evidence-package.json完整告警证据包，包含受控重放原始查询/alert来源、实际身份与责任、缺失/零值、重置/身份替换/修复持续增量，以及独立真实loopback证据。上层保存完整native-evidence.json sidecar与printed SHA。真实TCP仅自有backlog1+8 clients约4秒；UDP4096*128B有界包/CPU观测，不承诺整机CPU饱和，不把应用接收缺口当NIC drop。未实测到真实重传则失败，不硬写成功。

## 验收方法
先实际promtool check config；真实exporter textfile原子替换、Prometheus新采样/rule/query/alerts API，全程case_id/资产身份动态绑定。三类单独/混合、missing/zero、新接口同名、reset窗口、修复前后增长与link-change边界验证。真实loopback保留socket TCP_INFO/raw、/proc SNMP、node原生TCP query及实际firing rule、包数和进程CPU。Python产物逐phase与原native receipts一致，保留不可推断物理故障的边界。最后核自有PID/startticks/cwd，进程回收、reader停止、目录移除、默认UID/HOME/PATH不变。参考/骨架/负例/早退/两不同错解/合法替代均按新源SHA验收；作者不自审。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import contextlib,io,traceback,sys,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from evidence_sidecar import record,final_sha
record('CHECKER_STARTED',{'uid':__import__('os').getuid()})
buffer=io.StringIO();error=None
try:
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buffer):
  import network_case
  network_case.work()
except BaseException as exc:
 error=type(exc).__name__;record('CHECKER_EXCEPTION',{'type':error,'traceback':traceback.format_exc()});raise
finally:
 record('HELPER_STDOUT',{'text':buffer.getvalue()});record('CHECKER_FINALLY',{'exception_type':error});print('NATIVE_EVIDENCE_SHA256:'+final_sha())
print('ALL_TESTS_PASSED')
test_files.checks/policy-contract.json: {"sources": {"crc": {"layer": "physical_link", "unit": "events", "origin": "constructed controlled hardware CRC counter stream, not physical ethtool capture or injected CRC", "reset_conditions": ["driver_or_device_reset", "host_boot", "interface_recreation"], "entry": "network hardware owner: cable/optic/port and corroborating peer CRC; replace only after physical corroboration"}, "drop": {"layer": "driver_queue", "unit": "packets", "origin": "constructed controlled driver drop counter stream; application UDP receive deficit is not driver drop", "reset_conditions": ["driver_reset", "host_boot", "interface_recreation"], "entry": "kernel/driver owner: ring/queue/CPU/softirq, firmware and driver counters"}, "tcp": {"layer": "transport", "unit": "segments", "origin": "controlled SNMP replay plus separate actual kernel Tcp_RetransSegs and own TCP_INFO", "reset_conditions": ["network_stack_or_host_restart"], "entry": "application and TCP stack owner: socket/backlog/RTT/path, not proof of bad NIC"}}, "asset_responsibility": {"key": ["asset", "interface_id", "boot_id"], "device_name_alone_is_identity": false, "metadata": ["speed_mbps", "duplex", "carrier", "link_changes"], "missing_hardware_counter": "unknown, never synthesize zero", "reset": "native counter-aware rate, not signed delta or absolute cumulative count", "repair": "compare sustained new increments; accumulated old totals need not clear", "replacement": "device name reuse or TCP retransmission alone cannot authorize card replacement"}, "limitations": ["Explicit controlled hardware statistics replay; no real CRC or driver drop injection claimed", "Real bounded loopback workload demonstrates application packets/CPU and per-socket TCP retransmission, not whole-host CPU saturation", "Actual host SNMP/Prom counters include other activity; own TCP_INFO establishes local causal evidence", "No NIC settings, firewall, sysctl, namespaces, default identity or global PATH changed"]}
